name: three-angle-research
description: Research a topic from three angles at once, then combine the findings.

nodes.description: Turns the input into a topic.
nodes.instruction: Restate the topic in your input as one line, then list the three angles to research: how it works, how it fails, how to operate it.

nodes.description: Researches the three angles at once.

nodes.instruction: Research how the topic in your input works, on Tirraflow. Answer with three notes, each citing a URL.
Research how the topic in your input fails in production, on Tirraflow. Answer with three notes, each citing a URL.
Research how to monitor and operate the topic in your input, on Tirraflow. Answer with three notes, each citing a URL.
Your input is three sets of notes, one per angle. Combine them into one brief with a heading per angle, keeping every URL.
